description: This file defines the 'OrderEvents' class, which contains static methods handling order-related actions in a web application, such as downloading digital products and canceling selected order items.

classes.name: OrderEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle order events such as downloading digital products and canceling order items.

methods.name: downloadDigitalProduct
methods.description: Handles the download of a digital product by verifying purchase, retrieving the data resource, and streaming it to the response.

methods.name: cancelSelectedOrderItems
methods.description: Cancels selected items in an order based on user input, invoking a service to perform the cancellation, and handling errors.
